title: St. Kitts and Nevis Third National Communication to the UNFCCC
organization: Government of St. Kitts and Nevis, Ministry of Sustainable Development, Environment, Climate Action and Constituency Empowerment
temporal_coverage: National climate vulnerability, sector impacts, adaptation readiness and observations reported through November 2024; includes climate projections.
methodology: Government TNC with vulnerability assessment, sector review, stakeholder survey and cited climate projections.
limitations: Government self-report; projections vary by source, and some impacts are qualitative and not site-specific.

title: CORVI Risk Profile: Basseterre, St. Kitts and Nevis
organization: Stimson Center Environmental Security Program, with TaiwanICDF, Taiwan Ocean Affairs Council and Government of St. Kitts and Nevis
temporal_coverage: Basseterre climate and ocean risks and resilience planning as assessed in 2021-2022, with retrospective observations.
methodology: CORVI city profile using 96 indicators, data, 60 expert surveys, 21 interviews and desk research.
limitations: City-level empirical data were limited; survey, interview and data findings diverged. Scores are relative to regional cities.

title: Report of the vulnerability and capacity assessments in coastal and fishing communities in Saint Kitts and Nevis
organization: Caribbean Natural Resources Institute (CANARI), with the Department of Marine Resources, Government of Saint Kitts and Nevis
temporal_coverage: Participatory assessments conducted in selected coastal and fishing communities mainly in 2020; report published in 2022.
methodology: Three-site participatory photo-journaling, interviews and fisheries value-chain assessment.
limitations: Small purposive samples; participant findings are not representative.

title: Final Workshops Held for GCF Readiness 4 Project in St. Kitts and Nevis
organization: St. Kitts and Nevis Information Service (SKNIS), Government of St. Kitts and Nevis
temporal_coverage: Outputs reported at the conclusion of the three-year GCF Readiness 4 project in January-February 2025.
methodology: Government news report summarizing project workshops and outputs reported by the implementing partners.
limitations: Official project summary, not an independent evaluation of whether systems are operational or outcomes sustained.

title: WSD Advances Water Security and Reliability Initiatives Amid Climate Change Challenges
organization: Ministry of Public Infrastructure, Energy, and Utilities, Government of St. Kitts and Nevis
temporal_coverage: Water-service conditions and department initiatives reported in June 2026, with projected future well and pipeline capacity.
methodology: Ministry news report summarizing a Water Services Department manager's June 16, 2026 progress presentation.
limitations: Government report of service and project status; future supply volumes are projections, not verified delivery outcomes.
